subject: School Committee Rules Document Revision
overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed and amended several sections of a proposed School Committee rules packet, focusing on meeting schedules, parliamentary procedures, and communication protocols. The body finalized the draft and referred it to the regular meeting for formal adoption.

items.title: Rule 51: Meeting Start and End Times
items.summary: Approved changing the regular meeting start time to 6:00 p.m. and established a 9:30 p.m. adjournment time unless extended by a two-thirds vote.

items.title: Rule 67: Rescind and Reconsider
items.summary: Approved Rule 67 with an amendment to include parenthetical references and hyperlinks to Robert's Rules of Order for public clarity.

items.title: Rule 77: Communications with City Council
items.summary: Approved an amended rule establishing that motions passed by the City Council regarding the schools will be reviewed by the Chair and Superintendent to determine if they require a formal agenda item.

items.title: Rules 82 and 83: Monitoring Remote Participation
items.summary: Approved merging the items to mandate that the secretary and superintendent or a designated administrator monitor remote participant hand-raises.

items.title: Rule 84: Superintendent Attendance
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the attendance rule providing exceptions for illness, bereavement, or emergencies.

items.title: Administrative Cleanup and Reporting
items.summary: Approved a motion authorizing the secretary to add cross-references to state law and policy, and referred the final document to the next regular meeting for approval.

items.title: Rule 90: Agenda Tracking System
items.summary: Approved technical corrections and terminology changes to the rule governing the internal tracking of agenda items and subcommittee referrals.

items.title: Rule 85: Custodian of Records
items.summary: Amended the rule to require the Superintendent to ensure a custodian of records is appointed and publicly identified on the district website rather than naming the Superintendent as custodian.
